question: What is the observed shared AlphaBeta evaluation-path cost for fixed-foe standard-Chess games at a 20k combined-node cap, without observing or retaining W/L labels?
scope: 32 deterministic evaluation-cost slots from 16 fresh seeded 8-ply roots, each played in both candidate colors. Uniform material model on both sides; no training, endpoint selection, outcome labels, or learned weights.

roots.actions: sorted legal UCI actions; uniform random choice; no material-dependent action choice
roots.reuse: Cost-only roots are excluded from any later actual-strength evaluation.

accounting: Candidate and fixed-foe nodes both charged to each slot. Incomplete searches contribute their actual node count and no action. Rule terminal is recorded only as a boolean stopping reason; winner/draw values are never read into outputs.
interpretation_limit: Uniform-policy execution-cost sample only; not learner-specific strength, an evaluation of trained endpoints, or a W/L result.
